mechanisms.mechanism_comment: Geater inhibitory potency for JAK1, JAK2 and TYK2 relative to JAK3.
Inhibits FGFR phosphorylation and signalling which decreases viability in cells with abnormal FGFR.
mechanisms.selectivity_comment: Active against FGFR1, FGFR2, FGFR3 and FGFR4. Also binds to RET, CSF1R, PDGFRA, PDGFRB, FLT4, KIT and VEGFR2.
